Subject: Need help with a land dispute case

Hello, my name is Girish Apte. I am a 59-year-old government clerk living in Thane. I have a land dispute with Harish Varghese over land worth 48.5 lakh rupees, and relatives dispute who owns the ancestral land. My case number is R.C.S. No. 2404/2022 in the Thane District Court. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 08800434072 or email girish.apte33@example.com.
